从专业软件到 Agent 工具:
From specialist software
to agent tools
同一个“光学实验”可能同时需要几何、复波场、器件端口、量子态和探测器模型。软件之: An optical experiment can involve geometry, complex fields, device ports, quantum states and detector models. Their physical quantities and conventions connect the software.
模型是否表达了你要研究的效应？: Does the model represent the effect?
几何光线适合宏观系统；衍射需要复场；亚波长器件常需全波；量子关联需要量子态。工具: Rays describe many macroscopic systems; diffraction needs complex fields; subwavelength devices often require full-wave methods; quantum correlations need quantum states.
API 与脚本是主要可执行能力: APIs and scripts execute the work
LLM 可以编写程序调用现有求解器。MCP 统一调用与检索入口；Skill 提供: LLMs can write programs that call existing solvers. MCP exposes retrieval or execution tools; Skills provide working knowledge. A Python library can be useful to an agent without a dedicated MCP.
开源客户端、免费本地功能、收费求解器和受限 PDK 可能同时出现。“可下载”“有: An open client, free local features, a paid solver and a restricted PDK can coexist. Downloadable, source-available and free describe different conditions.
点击领域可进入筛选目录。一个工具可跨多个领域，领域数字不相加；产品族按一项统计。: Select a domain to filter the directory. Tools can span domains, so domain counts are not additive. A product family counts as one entry.
每项均列出用途、物理方法、编程入口、计算方式、许可边界和来源。勾选最多四项，可并: Each entry records purpose, methods, interfaces, computation, licensing and sources. Select up to four entries for a side-by-side comparison.
搜索软件、物理方法和接口: Search software, physical methods and interfaces
搜索：软件名、FDTD、Python、GPU、相位、镀膜…: Search: software, FDTD, Python, GPU, phase, coatings…
没有匹配条目。可清除关键词或放宽领域、接口条件。: No matching entries. Clear the search or broaden the domain and interface filters.
把模型表示作为软件之间的共同语言，可以减少不必要的格式转换，也能看清每条计算链的: Use physical representations as the common language between tools. This clarifies data exchange and the approximations made at each step.
镜头、照明、杂散光、宏观场景: Lenses, lighting, stray light, macroscopic scenes
是否需要相位、衍射或偏振？仅有光线轨迹通常不足以回答相干问题。: Do phase, diffraction or polarization matter? Ray paths alone generally cannot answer coherent-optics questions.
复振幅 E(x,y)、偏振与相位: Complex amplitude E(x,y), polarization and phase
自由空间传播、PSF、全息、AO: Free-space propagation, PSFs, holography, adaptive optics
标量、近轴和采样条件是否成立？高 NA 或亚波长结构需要更精细模型。: Are scalar, paraxial and sampling assumptions valid? High NA and subwavelength structures can require more detailed models.
空间电磁场 E、H 与材料响应: Spatial E and H fields and material response
网格 / 基组、色散、PML 和边界是否收敛？不宜把宏观实验台直接整体离散。: Converge meshes / bases, dispersion, PML and boundaries. Discretizing an entire macroscopic bench is usually impractical.
层、周期、模态或散射基底系数: Layer, periodic, modal or scattering-basis coefficients
薄膜、光栅、晶体、颗粒、波导: Thin films, gratings, crystals, particles, waveguides
快速来自结构假设；平面层、无限周期、模态截断各自有物理边界。: Efficiency comes from structure: planar layers, infinite periodicity and modal truncation have distinct validity limits.
端口复幅度、S 参数、时间包络: Complex port amplitudes, S-parameters, temporal envelopes
PIC、通信链路、超快光纤、腔系统: PICs, communication links, ultrafast fibers, cavities
器件紧凑模型、频率、相位、功率与采样的约定必须统一。: Compact models must agree on frequency, phase, power and sampling conventions.
态矢量、密度矩阵、量子信道: State vectors, density matrices, quantum channels
量子光学、耗散、单光子与连续变量: Quantum optics, dissipation, single photons, continuous variables
经典电磁场与量子算符是不同表示；耦合参数需要明确的物理来源。: Classical fields and quantum operators are different representations. Coupling parameters need a defined physical origin.
光子包权重、路径与时间统计: Photon-packet weights, paths and timing statistics
组织、强散射介质、扩散光学: Tissue, strongly scattering media, diffuse optics
通常不保留相干相位；适合能量与时间分布，不直接模拟干涉。: Typically does not preserve coherent phase; models energy and timing distributions rather than interference.
执行建模、求解与结果读取的底层入口。Agent 写代码后，可直接使用 Pytho: Underlying interfaces execute modeling, solving and result retrieval. Agents can write Python, Julia, command-line or vendor-language programs.
把特定能力暴露为可发现工具。服务器可能只检索文档，也可能操作软件；必须看工具范围: Exposes particular capabilities as discoverable tools. A server may only retrieve documentation or may operate software; inspect its actual tools.
封装使用说明、模板和辅助脚本。软件里的普通插件不自动等同于 Agent Skil: Packages instructions, templates and helper scripts. Application plugins are not automatically agent Skills, and a Skill does not supply a solver license.
建议保留专业软件原生 API，让 Agent 能生成和修改完整程序；对常用任务增: Preserve native APIs so agents can generate and modify complete programs. Add stable tool interfaces for common tasks while retaining access to new models, algorithms and complex workflows.
Flexcompute 插件中的文档检索、编辑器桥接和 Python 执行是不同: Flexcompute documentation retrieval, editor bridges and Python execution are separate capabilities. An official Ansys repository does not by itself establish commercial support for every release. Open the linked sources for details.
成像系统的数字模型: A digital model of an imaging system
传递瞳面复场或像差、PSF、像元尺寸、光谱响应和噪声参数；空间坐标与单位保持一致: Exchange pupil fields or aberrations, PSFs, pixel size, spectral response and noise parameters. Keep coordinates and units consistent.
从单波长理想点源扩展到实际光谱、像差和探测器响应；用测量数据校准参数。: Extend ideal monochromatic sources to actual spectra, aberrations and detectors; calibrate parameters against measurements.
亚波长设计跨越到宏观性能: Connect subwavelength design to system performance
传递复数透射 / 反射矩阵及角度、偏振、波长依赖，不能只传“相位图”。: Exchange complex transmission / reflection matrices with angle, polarization and wavelength dependence, rather than a phase map alone.
局域周期近似会忽略单元耦合与边缘效应；大角度和强梯度区域需要更高保真模型。: Local periodic approximations omit cell coupling and edge effects. Large angles and strong gradients may require higher-fidelity models.
传递工艺层、材料、截面、端口及复数 S 参数；记录参考平面、频率和模态归一化。: Exchange process layers, materials, cross-sections, ports and complex S-parameters; record reference planes, frequencies and modal normalization.
PDK 决定可制造边界；DRC 合格不等于光学性能合格，理想电路也不等于有工艺容: The PDK defines process constraints. Passing DRC does not establish optical performance, and ideal circuits do not include manufacturing tolerances.
传递复包络、时间网格、中心频率、色散、非线性与噪声定义；区分场幅值和光功率。: Exchange complex envelopes, time grids, carrier frequency, dispersion, nonlinearity and noise definitions. Distinguish field amplitude from power.
宽带脉冲或强非线性可能超出简单包络假设；参数更新应来自实际光纤与器件表征。: Broadband pulses or strong nonlinearities can exceed simple envelope assumptions; update parameters from actual fiber and device characterization.
传递热致面形、折射率变化、腔长、模式失配和噪声谱；定义相同的工作点。: Exchange thermal surface deformation, refractive-index changes, cavity length, mode mismatch and noise spectra at a consistent operating point.
多物理场耦合不必让一个求解器承担全部任务；先明确每个子模型向下游传递的物理量。: Coupled physics can use multiple solvers. First define the physical quantities each model supplies to the next.
MCX / MMC；相干问题选波动模型: MCX / MMC; wave models for coherent problems
根据实验模式选择数据：光子通量、时间响应、强度图、衍射图或复场，不能混用。: Choose the relevant observable: photon fluence, time response, intensity, diffraction patterns or complex fields. These are not interchangeable.
扩散断层、全息显微与 ptychography 的观测算子不同；重建算法必须匹配: Diffuse tomography, holographic microscopy and ptychography use different observation operators. Reconstruction must match the forward model.
数字孪生需要持续对应真实对象: A digital twin stays tied to a real system
仿真器提供前向模型；测量把模型参数约束到真实仪器；代理模型在明确的参数域内加速计: A simulator provides a forward model; measurements constrain its parameters to the real instrument; a surrogate accelerates evaluation within a defined domain. They serve complementary roles.
θ：几何、材料、校准与噪声参数；u：输入与控制；y：观测量。代理模型 F̂ 的有: θ: geometry, materials, calibration and noise; u: inputs and controls; y: observations. Data and validation determine the valid domain of the surrogate F̂.
明确是哪台仪器、哪一版几何、哪些材料和工作条件。: Identify the instrument, geometry revision, materials and operating conditions.
把求解器输出转换为实际探测器会测到的量。: Transform solver outputs into quantities the actual detector measures.
用数据估计参数和偏差，保留不确定度与适用条件。: Estimate parameters and biases from data, preserving uncertainty and validity conditions.
在可用范围内用低成本模型探索，并回到物理模型或实验检验关键候选。: Explore with low-cost models within their valid domains, then check important candidates with physics or experiments.
输入厚度与波长都用 nm；扫描输出可以直接进入拟合或优化器。: Use nm for both thickness and wavelength. Sweep results can feed a fit or optimizer.
示例常数；真实材料应用色散数据: Illustrative constants; use measured dispersion for real materials
用 Python 表达设计；输出制造版图。具体流片需加载真实 PDK。: Express geometry in Python and export a layout. Fabrication requires the actual process PDK.
使用内置通用示例 PDK: Activate the built-in generic example PDK
gdsfactory 几何参数通常以微米表示: gdsfactory geometry is usually expressed in micrometers
示例假设已有 device.fsp，其中 core 与 transmission: Requires an existing device.fsp with core and transmission objects, run in a licensed environment.
先推导薄透镜与自由传播的 ABCD 关系，再生成可执行数值函数。: Derive the thin-lens and free-space ABCD relation, then generate a numerical function.
z、f 均以 m 表示: Both z and f are in meters
客户端开放源码，主要云求解需要计费：归商业付费组。: Open client; principal cloud solving is paid. Listed in the commercial group.
本地设计与电路功能免费，但不据此认定整个平台开源；云器件求解计费：单列。: Free local design and circuits do not establish an entirely open-source platform; cloud device solves are paid. Listed separately.
源码可读，许可证限制学术与非商业用途：不放入无领域限制的开源组。: Readable source with academic / noncommercial restrictions. Not included in the unrestricted open-source group.
EDU 免费且功能受限；商业试用仍归相应商业产品，不混入完全免费工具。: EDU is free with limited features. Commercial trials remain under the corresponding commercial product.
PDK、材料库与厂商求解器: PDKs, material libraries and vendor solvers
宿主开源不自动覆盖这些资源的许可；逐项识别依赖。: An open host does not automatically license these resources. Identify each dependency separately.
可训练、可微不代表已具有校准过的光学知识；需明确训练数据、目标与有效参数域。: Trainable or differentiable does not mean optically calibrated. Specify training data, objectives and the valid parameter domain.
浏览器未启用 JavaScript：软件条目和来源仍可阅读；搜索、筛选与比较需要: JavaScript is disabled. Entries and sources remain readable; search, filters and comparison require JavaScript.

按物理任务查找设计、仿真与分析工具，比较许可、计算环境和编程接口。: Find tools by physical task. Compare licensing, compute requirements and programming interfaces.
连接器按官方、社区与未核实标注；原生 API 和脚本入口单独列出。: Connectors are marked official, community or unverified. Native APIs and scripts are listed separately.
按原始项目和官方文档整理连接器功能、来源与计算入口。: Connector capabilities, provenance and execution interfaces, with links to project and vendor documentation.
六类数字实验的模型组合、交接数据与物理条件。: Model combinations, exchanged data and physical conditions for six types of digital experiment.
四个 Python 示例展示输入、调用与输出，运行条件随示例列出。: Four Python examples show inputs, calls and outputs, with prerequisites listed alongside each example.
覆盖光学设计、仿真、重建，以及材料、几何和数值计算基础。按物理方法、用途与可编程: Tools and product families for optical design, simulation and reconstruction, together with materials, geometry and numerical foundations. Organized by physical method, purpose and programmable interface.
每项列出应用依据、模型条件和软件依赖，便于结合具体任务选择。: Each entry records its application basis, model assumptions and software dependencies to support task-specific selection.
